name: 90744 · Wilmington, CA
findings: ZIP 90744 (Wilmington) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90744 (Wilmington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90744 (Wilmington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
